title: Skippable In-Stream
tagline: Views from people who chose to keep watching.
description: Skippable in-stream ads play before, during, or after other videos on YouTube. Viewers can skip after five seconds, so the people who stay are the ones who are interested. It is the format most campaigns start with when the goal is video views.
challenge: Use it when you want your video watched by people who have a reason to care. It suits longer videos, channel trailers, product explainers, and anything where the first five seconds can earn the rest. A link can sit alongside the ad for viewers who want to do something next.
approach: We start with your goal and budget, then define the audience and set up the campaign around the video you want seen. You approve the targeting and the price before anything goes live.
outcome: A campaign built around your video, with the audience, schedule, and budget agreed up front. After it runs, you get a report covering views, impressions, view rate, and spend, so you can see what the budget delivered.
quote: Every campaign is quoted before it starts. You will know the format, the audience, and the budget before anything goes live, and the report afterwards shows where the spend went.
author: WEB3TASK

title: Non-Skippable In-Stream
tagline: Your whole message, start to finish.
description: Non-skippable in-stream ads are short video ads, typically fifteen seconds or less, that play in full before, during, or after other videos. Viewers cannot skip them, so the entire message is shown every time the ad is served.
challenge: Use it when the message is short and needs to be seen whole: an announcement, a release date, a single offer. It works best with a tight edit made for the format, not a longer video cut down at the last minute.
approach: We check that your video fits the format, agree the audience and schedule with you, and set a budget based on how many people you want to reach. Pricing is confirmed before launch.
outcome: A short, complete message delivered to a defined audience. Your report shows impressions, reach, and spend for the campaign period.
quote: Short formats leave no room for a slow start. If your video needs a trim to fit, we will tell you before you spend anything on it.
author: WEB3TASK

title: Bumper Ads
description: Bumper ads are six seconds or shorter and cannot be skipped. They play before, during, or after other videos. They are built for one clear idea: a name, a date, a product, a reason to look closer.
challenge: Use them when you want a simple message to reach a wide audience, or to support a longer campaign with a short reminder. They are not the place for detail. If it takes more than a sentence to say, another format will serve it better.
approach: We help you decide what the six seconds should say, define who should see it, and set up the campaign alongside any longer formats you are running. You see the plan and the price first.
outcome: A short reminder running to the audience you chose, on the schedule you agreed. Reporting covers impressions, reach, and spend.
quote: Bumpers work best as part of a plan, not on their own. We will show you how they fit with your other formats before you commit budget to them.
author: WEB3TASK

title: In-Feed Video
tagline: Show up where people are browsing.
description: In-feed video ads appear as a thumbnail and text in YouTube search results, next to related videos, and on the Home feed. Nothing plays until the viewer chooses to click, so every view starts with a decision to watch.
challenge: Use it when your video answers something people are already looking for, or sits naturally next to videos they are already watching. It suits tutorials, reviews, music, and longer content, and it relies on a clear title and thumbnail.
approach: We look at where your video should appear, set up targeting around relevant topics and searches, and review the title and thumbnail with you before launch. Budget and pricing are agreed in advance.
outcome: Your video placed in front of people who are browsing for something like it. Your report shows impressions, views, and spend, so you can see how often the placement led to a watch.
quote: With in-feed ads the thumbnail does most of the work. We review it with you before launch, because that is far cheaper than finding out afterwards.
author: WEB3TASK

title: Shorts Ads
description: Shorts ads are vertical video ads that appear between Shorts in the Shorts feed. Viewers swipe past them like any other Short, so they need to be made for a phone screen and get to the point quickly.
challenge: Use them when your audience spends time in the Shorts feed and you have, or can make, vertical video. They suit quick introductions, teasers, and anything that reads at a glance.
approach: We check your video is formatted for vertical viewing, define the audience, and set up the campaign with a budget you have approved. If your footage is horizontal, we will tell you what that means before you launch.
outcome: Your vertical video running in the Shorts feed to the audience you selected. Reporting covers views, impressions, and spend.
quote: Not every video belongs in the Shorts feed. If a different format would suit yours better, we will say so and explain why.
author: WEB3TASK

title: Channel Growth
tagline: Put your best video in front of new viewers.
description: A channel growth campaign promotes one or more of your videos to people who are likely to be interested in the rest of your channel. It is planned around your content and your audience, not a fixed package.
challenge: Use it when you have a channel worth discovering and a video that represents it well. It suits creators who want new viewers to find them, and businesses building a channel as a long-term home for their video.
approach: We pick the video and format with you, define an audience based on the topics and interests your channel covers, and agree a budget and timeline. You see the full plan before it starts.
outcome: A campaign that introduces your channel to a defined audience, with a report on views, impressions, and spend. What viewers do next depends on your content, and we will not promise numbers we cannot control.
quote: We do not promise subscribers. Advertising can put your video in front of the right people; whether they stay is down to the channel. We will always be straight with you about that.
author: WEB3TASK

title: Video Launch
tagline: Support a new upload from day one.
description: A video launch campaign is planned around a release date. The audience, format, and budget are agreed ahead of time, so promotion can begin when your video goes live instead of days later.
challenge: Use it for a music video, a trailer, a series premiere, or any upload where timing matters. It works best when we can plan before the release, with the video or a preview available to review.
approach: We agree the launch date, format, and audience with you in advance, prepare the campaign, and switch it on when the video is public. Support is on hand during the launch if anything needs to change.
outcome: A campaign ready to run on your release date, with the price confirmed beforehand. After the launch window you receive a report covering views, impressions, and spend.
quote: Launches go more smoothly with notice. Tell us your release date as early as you can, and we will have the campaign ready before the video is.
author: WEB3TASK

title: Product Launch
tagline: Introduce something new to the right audience.
description: A product launch campaign uses video to introduce a new product, service, or feature to a defined audience. It often combines formats: a longer video for people who want detail, and shorter ads to keep the launch visible.
challenge: Use it when you have something new to show and video that explains it. It suits businesses of any size, from a first product to an addition to an existing range.
approach: We map your launch plan to formats and audiences, agree how the budget is split between them, and set up each part of the campaign. You approve the plan and pricing before launch.
outcome: A coordinated campaign across the formats you chose, with one report covering views, impressions, reach, and spend for each.
quote: When a campaign uses more than one format, you will see the cost of each part separately. No single line that hides how the budget was divided.
author: WEB3TASK

title: Website Traffic
tagline: Send viewers somewhere after they watch.
description: A website traffic campaign pairs your video with a link, so interested viewers can go to your site, store, or sign-up page. It is planned around what you want people to do after they watch.
challenge: Use it when the video is a first step and the destination matters: a shop, a booking page, a course, an app. It works best when the page viewers land on continues what the video started.
approach: We set up the campaign with your link, define the audience, and agree the budget with you. We will also check that the destination page is working before any spend begins.
outcome: Your video running with a clear next step for viewers. Reporting covers views, impressions, clicks, and spend.
quote: We report clicks as clicks. What happens on your website after that is yours to measure, and we are happy to explain how to line the two up.
author: WEB3TASK

title: Local Awareness
description: A local awareness campaign shows your video to people in the area you choose: a city, a region, or the places you serve. It is a way for local businesses, venues, and events to use video without paying to reach people who are too far away to visit.
challenge: Use it when where your audience lives matters as much as what they are interested in. It suits shops, restaurants, services, venues, and events with a date and a place.
approach: We define the area with you, add interest or topic targeting where it helps, and set a budget that fits the size of the audience. Pricing is confirmed before the campaign starts.
outcome: Your video shown within the area you selected, on the dates you agreed. Your report covers views, impressions, and spend for that area.
quote: Smaller areas mean smaller audiences. We will tell you roughly how many people your targeting can reach before you decide on a budget.
author: WEB3TASK
